meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编码前产出决策完备的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不先理清方案就写代码总返工。
copy.tagline_en: Produce a decision-complete work plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan before starting implementation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成只做规划的顾问:先做只读调研,把需求整理成一份让后续执行者不用再追问的完整工作计划,写入 .omo/ 目录;在你说“可以”之前绝不进入编码实现;你说“做某某”也会被当成“先计划某某”。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确提到 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求“实施前先出计划”时激活;裸跑 ulw 不会自启,须显式请求。

say.text: 请进入 ulw-plan,先为我这个需求出实施前计划。
say.note: 进入计划模式,开始只读探索

say.text: 我要重构支付模块,先写决策完整的工作计划,别碰代码。
say.note: 把重构当计划任务,产出计划待你批准

say.text: 给这个新功能先做一份实施前规划,再谈执行。
say.note: 计划书会写入 .omo/,批准后才动工

howto.what_en: Acting as a planning consultant, Claude explores read-only, then writes one decision-complete work plan under .omo/ and never implements. Plan mode is sticky: 'do X' means 'plan X'; execution starts only after explicit approval.
howto.when_en: Activates only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation. A bare ulw run never triggers it.

say_en.text: Enter ulw-plan and draft a pre-implementation plan for this request.
say_en.note: Enters plan mode and starts read-only exploration

say_en.text: I want to refactor the payment module: write a decision-complete plan first, no code.
say_en.note: Treats the refactor as a planning task pending your go-ahead

say_en.text: Prepare an implementation plan for this new feature before we execute.
say_en.note: The plan is saved under .omo/; work starts only after approval
